title: Evaluation of the ABCG2 charge model in protein–ligand binding affinity calculations
authors: Sudarshan Behera; Vytautas Gapsys; Bert de Groot
one_liner_zh: 该文评估ABCG2电荷模型在蛋白质-配体结合自由能计算中的表现，对象为小分子配体而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合机制研究，仅方法上涉及自由能模拟，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: Accurate binding free energy prediction is vital for drug design, motivating the assessment of new force field models. Here, we evaluate the ABCG2 charge model with nonequilibrium alchemical free energy simulations. GAFF2/ABCG2 achieves higher hydration free energy accuracy, but does not outperform GAFF2/AM1-BCC for protein–ligand binding free energy. Both charge models show comparable accuracy and compound ranking across targets, highlighting that optimizing a force field for a particular molecular property does not necessarily lead to better performance in other, even closely related, properties.
abstract_zh: 准确的结合自由能预测对药物设计至关重要，这促使对新力场模型进行评估。在此，我们通过非平衡态炼金术自由能模拟评估了ABCG2电荷模型。GAFF2/ABCG2在 hydration free energy（水合自由能）精度上表现更优，但在蛋白质-配体结合自由能方面并未超越GAFF2/AM1-BCC。两种电荷模型在跨靶标的精度和化合物排序上显示出相当的性能，这突显了针对特定分子性质优化力场并不必然导致在其他性质（即便是密切相关性质）上的更好表现。
